description: Returns everything needed to call one Wafermap resource: its USD price, the JSON Schema of its input, a ready-to-use example input, what it returns, and its HTTP endpoint. Use it after wafermap_resources and before wafermap_call so the input is valid (invalid input is rejected before any payment). Free, no payment needed.

id.description: Resource id from wafermap_resources, e.g. "stock-signal" or "prediction-markets".

name: wafermap_resource_schema
title: Get one resource's input schema
